issue: Do unlawfully present noncitizens have Second Amendment rights to bear arms?

sides.position: Unlawfully present noncitizens do not possess Second Amendment rights to bear arms.
cases: United States v. Portillo-Munoz, 643 F.3d 437 (5th Cir. 2011)
United States v. Sitladeen, 64 F.4th 978 (8th Cir. 2023)

sides.position: Unlawfully present noncitizens retain Second Amendment rights to bear arms.
cases: United States v. Carpio-Leon, 701 F.3d 974 (4th Cir. 2012)
United States v. Meza-Rodriguez, 798 F.3d 664 (7th Cir. 2015)

quote: Even if he were correct about the scope of the right, whether noncitizens possess a right to bear arms is an unanswered question currently dividing the circuits.
cite: United States v. Barragan-Gutierrez, 133 F.4th 1101 (10th Cir. 2025)
